name: Outskirt Raiders
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Raider
specialRules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ambush Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Raider Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Raider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Surge when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Surge when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Raider
specialRules.description: If this model has Raider, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Raider (instead of only results of 6).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Defense Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Shatter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).

specialRules.name: Vengeance
specialRules.description: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.

specialRules.name: Vicious
specialRules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Vicious
specialRules.description: If this model has Vicious, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Vicious (instead of only results of 6).

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
